title: Chapter 2680 - 79: Strange (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 2680: Chapter 79: Strange (Part 3)

"So there is someone who found a way, used some means, to prevent evil thoughts from affecting the barbarian slaves?"

"In this way, these barbarian slaves, used as ’rations’, won’t be influenced by evil thoughts and won’t ’spoil’?"

"What means..."

Mo Hua soon thought of those iron cages.

These barbarian slaves were previously locked inside iron cages.

Mo Hua walked to the iron cage, unleashed his Divine Sense, and meticulously searched every corner, suddenly his expression turned shocked.

"Elder Ba Shan." Mo Hua called out.

Not far away, Elder Ba Shan, who was sorting barbarian armor supplies, immediately ran over upon hearing his name.

Ever since Elder Ba Shan had his life ’saved’ by Mo Hua, and witnessed Mo Hua manifesting holiness in front of people, his attitude towards Mo Hua had become exceedingly respectful.

He used to think that the shaman couldn’t possibly look like Mo Hua.

But now he deeply believes that the shaman should exactly look like Mo Hua.

Mo Hua then pointed at the iron cage and said, "Take apart all these iron cages, and dig up the foundation as well."

Ba Shan heard this without asking why, simply nodded and said, "Understood, Mr. Witch!"

The shaman adheres to the deity’s will, naturally there is a reason for his actions.

Ba Shan was very robust and strong, directly mobilizing Golden Core Power to forcibly dismantle the iron cage holding the barbarian slaves.

After dismantling, Mo Hua began scrutinizing the patterns at the bottom of the iron cages.

At a mere glance, Mo Hua’s pupils shrank immediately.

"This is..."

Divine Dao Formation Patterns?!

Inside the stone palace where Shugubu worshiped the Barbarian God, there were actually formation patterns of the Divine Dao field?

This implies that Shugubu is definitely not as simple as imagined.

There is, or at least was, a "master" in the Divine Dao within this tribe.

Were the evolution and rituals involving the Barbarian God in Shugubu studied, or even ’manipulated’ by someone?

Mo Hua’s expression became grave, and he immediately said to Ba Shan, "Break all the iron cages, dismantle all the foundations."

Elder Ba Shan did not know Mo Hua’s intentions.

But seeing Mr. Witch’s serious expression, aware that this matter might involve deities, he immediately spared no effort, dismantling all the iron cages one by one.

Mo Hua inspected all these Divine Dao Formation Patterns, feeling increasingly puzzled as he looked.

These patterns could isolate Divine Thought, conceal auras, and the traces seemed quite fresh.

They were surprisingly identical to the Divine Dao formations of Divine Mist, Divine Lock, and Divine Barrier that Mo Hua had learned.

The issue was, the Divine Dao formations Mo Hua learned were from Mr. Tu, the number one minion of the Evil God, in the Qian Learning State Boundary.

But Mr. Tu... he was already dead.

He died in the Blood Sacrifice Array, obliterated by Heavenly Tribulation, ashes scattered.

Here in the Barbaric Wilderness, who was the one inscribing the Divine Dao formation?

It couldn’t possibly be...

Mo Hua furrowed his brow, feeling a chill in his heart, but after a moment’s thought, he realized he should have thought rightly.

Mr. Tu came from the Great Wilderness, so his Divine Dao formations naturally also originated from the Great Wilderness.

Having someone able to inscribe Divine Dao formations here in the Great Wilderness is only reasonable.

Not every blame can be placed on Mr. Tu, who is already deceased...

Is there another "master" of the Divine Dao in Shugubu?

What was his purpose in inscribing these Divine Dao formations?

What exactly was his scheme?

Mo Hua considered using demon bone divination to calculate these Divine Dao formations, to look into the causality, but due to an instinctive dread, he restrained himself.

The enemy’s situation is unclear, their strength unknown, recklessly probing causality is not advisable.

Mo Hua now, is no longer that fearless rookie Mo Hua.

He also understands that causality is indeed perilous, especially when facing major situations, formidable enemies, and some unknown great terrors.

This principle, though Mo Hua knew before, was never really taken to heart.

At times he would still take chances.

Until his Uncle taught him a lesson on "fateful evilness," Mo Hua then remembered it deeply, never daring to be reckless again.

Mo Hua transcribed all these Divine Dao Formation Patterns, temporarily leaving them aside.

Without clues, no matter how much effort spent contemplating, it would be useless.

Moreover, Mo Hua had another, more important matter.

He thought for a moment, then said to Ba Shan:

"Elder Ba Shan, I need to enter seclusion temporarily, to beseech guidance from the Divine Lord. Please find me a quiet place and make sure I’m not disturbed."

Hearing "guidance from the Divine Lord," Elder Ba Shan indeed showed a very solemn expression, immediately saying:

"Mr. Witch, rest assured, I will arrange it well."

Elder Ba Shan found a quiet stone chamber in the stone palace, meticulously cleaned it, even laying down a soft wolfskin rug for Mo Hua to rest during seclusion.

Then he ordered people to guard the surroundings.

Ba Shan himself, did nothing else but "stood guard" for Mo Hua.

These cultivators of the barbarian tribes, have simple minds.

If they suspect you, or are hostile towards you, they naturally target you in various ways.

But if they trust you, respect you, they treat you earnestly well, with wholehearted enthusiasm without pretense.

Mo Hua felt a bit sentimental in his heart.

Afterward, he began to meditate in the stone chamber, closing his eyes and calming his thoughts, peacefully entering seclusion.

About four hours later, Mo Hua estimated the time, approximately at 1 p.m, and then sank his Divine Sense into the Sea of Consciousness.

In the center of the Sea of Consciousness, an ancient and deep Taoist Stele appeared.

On the Taoist Stele, a scarlet Tribulation Pattern surged.

Mo Hua then exhaled the half-silver half-green telekinesis of the Shugubu Barbarian God he’d just swallowed, and placed it on the Tribulation Thunder of the Taoist Stele to "roast" it a bit.

A fierce howl suddenly resounded, a white bone divine face transformed into a phantom and roared, and then amidst the flickering red light of the Tribulation Thunder, it was completely annihilated.

The already weak evil god’s intent within the "corrupted" Barbarian God of Shugubu completely dissipated.

After "detoxification," Mo Hua only then re-swallowed this telekinesis, assuredly refining it.

Strands of pure telekinesis merged into Mo Hua’s Divine Body, nourishing his Divine Sense.

And the faintly silvery-white Divine Marrow was also gradually absorbed by Mo Hua’s divine soul.

Abundant Divine Sense, along with Divine Marrow.

It’s a sensation not tasted for a long time, hard-earned indeed.

Mo Hua felt a comfort in his heart, slowly savoring it.

Time slowly passed.

Finally, all the telekinesis and Divine Marrow of the Shugubu Barbarian God were refined by Mo Hua, and Mo Hua’s Divine Sense ushered in a notable increase.

It surged from the middle of the twenty-two patterns to the pinnacle of twenty-two patterns.

Mo Hua had almost reached the threshold of twenty-three patterns of Divine Thought.

Twenty-three patterns of Divine Thought is the peak of Divine Thought Realm that an early-stage Golden Core cultivator can possess.

And Mo Hua, at the Foundation Establishment Late Stage, was only one step away from it.

Mo Hua let out a long breath, his eyes lit up with a slight brightness, only feeling that he had taken another step closer to the Golden Core he yearned for...
